__inputs.label: PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: Postgres datasource pointing at the secops_dashboard database

title: SecOps Cyber Team Worklist
description: Coverage gaps, data quality and triage queues for the cyber team

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content:
### Cyber Team Worklist
Coverage gaps, data-quality problems and triage queues -- the things to fix so every other dashboard and report is telling the truth. Point-in-time (the time picker doesn't apply), filtered by **Site**. Start with **Feed health**: a failing feed makes everything downstream stale.

panels.title: Collectors (latest run each)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (collector) collector AS "Collector", status AS "Status", started_at AS "Last run", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM finished_at - started_at))::int AS "Seconds", (SELECT max(started_at) FROM collector_runs c2 WHERE c2.collector = r.collector AND c2.status = 'ok') AS "Last success", left(error, 200) AS "Error" FROM collector_runs r ORDER BY collector, started_at DESC

panels.description: Disabled feeds keep their last run here. An 'error' row for a feed you rely on means its panels and report figures are stale since 'Last success'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen > now() - interval '7 days') a WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.title: Vulnerability assessment coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source_asset_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_asset_id FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'falcon_spotlight')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM (SELECT * FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen > now() - interval '7 days') a WHERE a.site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Active managed hosts Falcon has returned vulnerability data for. Everything below 100% is estate the vuln figures can't see.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen > now() - interval '7 days') a WHERE a.site_label IN ($site) AND a.source_asset_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_asset_id FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'falcon_spotlight')

panels.title: Stale sensors

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND last_seen <= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.description: Managed hosts silent for 7+ days: unprotected, unassessed, or decommissioned but not removed from Falcon.

panels.title: Named machines missing a sensor

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'workstation_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor')

panels.description: AD computer accounts in active use (servers, workstations, DCs) with no Falcon sensor -- Discover's unmanaged list minus duplicates, service accounts, appliances and stale objects. Network-only devices are counted separately below.

panels.title: Hosts in Ungrouped

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE NOT retired AND site_label = 'Ungrouped'

panels.description: Managed + unmanaged hosts no site rule matched (ignores the Site filter). Fix with falcon_groups / ou_contains / hostname_regex in config.yaml.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.site_label AS "Site", COALESCE(a.active,0) AS "Active hosts", COALESCE(a.assessed,0) AS "Assessed", round(100.0 * COALESCE(a.assessed,0) / NULLIF(a.active,0), 1) AS "% assessed", COALESCE(st.n,0) AS "Stale sensors", COALESCE(u.n,0) AS "Missing a sensor" FROM dim_site s LEFT JOIN (SELECT site_label, count(*) AS active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE source_asset_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_asset_id FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'falcon_spotlight')) AS assessed FROM (SELECT * FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen > now() - interval '7 days') x GROUP BY 1) a ON a.site_label = s.site_label LEFT JOIN (SELECT site_label, count(*) n FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen <= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1) st ON st.site_label = s.site_label LEFT JOIN (SELECT site_label, count(*) n FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND discovery_class IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'workstation_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor') GROUP BY 1) u ON u.site_label = s.site_label WHERE s.site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY "% assessed" NULLS LAST, "Active hosts" DESC

panels.title: Active hosts with no vulnerability data

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.hostname AS "Hostname", a.site_label AS "Site", a.product_type AS "Type", a.os_version AS "OS", a.sensor_version AS "Sensor", a.last_seen AS "Last seen", array_to_string(a.groups, ', ') AS "Host groups" FROM (SELECT * FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND last_seen > now() - interval '7 days') a WHERE a.site_label IN ($site) AND a.source_asset_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_asset_id FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'falcon_spotlight') ORDER BY a.site_label, a.hostname

panels.description: Compare sensor version, host groups and policy against assessed hosts to find what Exposure Management isn't covering.

panels.title: Stale sensors (silent 7+ days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname AS "Hostname", site_label AS "Site", product_type AS "Type", os_version AS "OS", last_seen AS "Last seen", (now()::date - last_seen::date) AS "Days silent", sensor_version AS "Sensor", array_to_string(ous, ' / ') AS "OU" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND last_seen <= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY last_seen

panels.description: Decommissioned: remove from Falcon. Still in use: fix the sensor.

panels.title: Unmanaged assets by class

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Domain controller, no sensor' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows server, no sensor' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows workstation, no sensor' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Cloud instance, no sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VMware NIC seen on network' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Device seen on network' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Appliance with an AD account' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Same name as a managed host' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Extra IP of a managed host' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Service account (gMSA/MSA)' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Cluster / listener name' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Outside this Falcon tenant' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Disabled AD computer account' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'AD account, no logon in 60+ days' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "Class", count(*) AS "Assets", CASE WHEN discovery_class IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'workstation_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor', 'vmware_nic', 'network_device') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Needs a sensor?", CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Install a sensor now (or retire the DC)' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Install a sensor, or record why it can''t have one' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Install a sensor; check it isn''t a renamed managed host' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Install a sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VM without a sensor, or an ESXi management interface: identify by IP' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Identify by IP/MAC vendor: PC needing a sensor, or printer/IoT/appliance' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Can''t take a sensor (ISE, vCenter, NAS...): confirm it''s known' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Already has a sensor -- Falcon didn''t link the AD record' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Shares a managed host''s MAC: cluster/listener IP or multi-homed' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Not a machine' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Not a machine (SQL AG listener, cluster or DAG name)' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Managed in another CID, or a departed service''s leftover AD object: no sensor needed here (collectors.falcon_hosts.out_of_scope_ous)' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Not in use: delete from AD when convenient' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'Probably gone: confirm and delete from AD' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "What to do" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY discovery_class ORDER BY "Needs a sensor?" DESC, "Assets" DESC

panels.description: Discover's unmanaged list, sorted into real machines without a sensor vs records that aren't missing endpoints at all. Classified by collectors/falcon_hosts.py.

panels.title: Servers, DCs and workstations with no sensor (AD accounts in use)

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname AS "Hostname", CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Domain controller, no sensor' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows server, no sensor' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows workstation, no sensor' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Cloud instance, no sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VMware NIC seen on network' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Device seen on network' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Appliance with an AD account' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Same name as a managed host' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Extra IP of a managed host' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Service account (gMSA/MSA)' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Cluster / listener name' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Outside this Falcon tenant' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Disabled AD computer account' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'AD account, no logon in 60+ days' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "Class", site_label AS "Site", os_version AS "OS", last_seen AS "Last AD logon", description AS "AD description", ad_created::date AS "AD account created", domain AS "Domain" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'workstation_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor') ORDER BY CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 1 WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 2 WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, site_label, hostname

panels.description: Real, in-use Windows machines Falcon knows from AD but that have no sensor. Install one, or record why not (vendor-supported clinical systems). A workstation here can also be a renamed managed host -- check the name in Falcon first.

panels.title: Missing sensors: devices seen on the network
Network devices with no sensor (passive discovery)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(hostname, '(no hostname)') AS "Hostname", CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Domain controller, no sensor' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows server, no sensor' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows workstation, no sensor' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Cloud instance, no sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VMware NIC seen on network' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Device seen on network' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Appliance with an AD account' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Same name as a managed host' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Extra IP of a managed host' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Service account (gMSA/MSA)' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Cluster / listener name' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Outside this Falcon tenant' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Disabled AD computer account' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'AD account, no logon in 60+ days' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "Class", COALESCE(mac_vendor, '?') AS "MAC vendor", array_to_string(ips, ', ') AS "IPs", array_to_string(mac_addresses, ', ') AS "MACs", site_label AS "Site", last_seen AS "Last seen" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class IN ('vmware_nic', 'network_device') ORDER BY mac_vendor NULLS LAST, site_label, ips

panels.description: Seen talking on the network by managed sensors, no AD account. VMware MACs are VMs without a sensor or ESXi management interfaces; Dell/Intel/HP/Lenovo NICs are often PCs; printers, phones and IoT can't take a sensor.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(mac_vendor, '(unknown)') AS "MAC vendor", count(*) AS "Devices", count(*) FILTER (WHERE hostname IS NOT NULL) AS "With hostname" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class IN ('vmware_nic', 'network_device') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Discover records that aren't unsensored machines

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname AS "Hostname", CASE discovery_class WHEN 'domain_controller_no_sensor' THEN 'Domain controller, no sensor' WHEN 'server_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows server, no sensor' WHEN 'workstation_no_sensor' THEN 'Windows workstation, no sensor' WHEN 'cloud_no_sensor' THEN 'Cloud instance, no sensor' WHEN 'vmware_nic' THEN 'VMware NIC seen on network' WHEN 'network_device' THEN 'Device seen on network' WHEN 'appliance_ad_account' THEN 'Appliance with an AD account' WHEN 'duplicate_of_managed' THEN 'Same name as a managed host' WHEN 'secondary_ip_of_managed' THEN 'Extra IP of a managed host' WHEN 'service_account' THEN 'Service account (gMSA/MSA)' WHEN 'cluster_name' THEN 'Cluster / listener name' WHEN 'out_of_scope' THEN 'Outside this Falcon tenant' WHEN 'disabled_ad_account' THEN 'Disabled AD computer account' WHEN 'stale_ad_account' THEN 'AD account, no logon in 60+ days' ELSE COALESCE(discovery_class, 'unclassified') END AS "Class", managed_twin AS "Managed host", site_label AS "Site", os_version AS "OS", ad_enabled AS "AD enabled", last_seen AS "Last AD logon", description AS "AD description" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND discovery_class NOT IN ('domain_controller_no_sensor', 'server_no_sensor', 'workstation_no_sensor', 'cloud_no_sensor', 'vmware_nic', 'network_device') ORDER BY discovery_class, hostname

panels.description: Duplicates of managed hosts (Falcon didn't link the AD object), service accounts, appliances, cluster/listener names, disabled or stale AD accounts. No sensor needed; disabled/stale ones are AD cleanup.

panels.title: Potential risks to triage

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND risk_type = 'Potential' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Unverified detections: confirm (promote) or dismiss in Hadrian.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND risk_type IN ('Verified','UnpatchedTechnology','InfectedDevice') AND site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND risk_type = 'InfectedDevice' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.title: Assets not matched by tag

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM external_assets WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND NOT retired AND site_matched_by <> 'hadrian_tag' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Tag these in Hadrian -- the collector also writes them to reports/hadrian-suggested-tags.csv.

panels.title: Assets not seen in 30 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM external_assets WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND (last_seen IS NULL OR last_seen < now() - interval '30 days')

panels.description: Hadrian hasn't observed these recently: gone, moved, or no longer reachable. Archive (zzArchive) if abandoned.

panels.title: Reopened risks

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state = 'REOPENED' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Risks marked fixed that Hadrian found again -- the fix didn't hold.

panels.title: Triage queue: potential risks by title

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Risk", max(plugin_family) AS "Category", max(vendor_priority) AS "Severity", count(*) AS "Open", count(DISTINCT site_label) AS "Sites", min(first_found)::date AS "Oldest" FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND risk_type = 'Potential' AND site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY title ORDER BY CASE max(vendor_priority) WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, count(*) DESC

panels.description: Grouped so one decision clears many: confirm or dismiss each title across its assets.

panels.title: Infostealer infections

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Infection", site_label AS "Site", hostname AS "Asset", first_found::date AS "First seen", state AS "State" FROM vuln_findings WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED') AND risk_type = 'InfectedDevice' AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY first_found

panels.description: Compromised credentials harvested from infected devices. Reset the named accounts and find the device. Not masked here -- this dashboard is for the cyber team.

panels.title: External assets: not tag-matched or not recently seen

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Asset", asset_type AS "Type", site_label AS "Site", site_matched_by AS "Site from", last_seen AS "Last seen by Hadrian" FROM external_assets WHERE source = 'hadrian' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND (site_matched_by <> 'hadrian_tag' OR last_seen IS NULL OR last_seen < now() - interval '30 days') ORDER BY last_seen NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Identities in Ungrouped, by domain and OU

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(domain, '(none)') AS "Domain", COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(ou, ',', 1), ''), '(none)') AS "OU (first part)", count(*) AS "Identities", count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled) AS "Enabled" FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND site_label = 'Ungrouped' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Ignores the Site filter. Each row is a mapping rule waiting to be written: add the domain or OU fragment to the right site in config.yaml.

panels.title: Identities per site

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.site_label AS "Site", count(e.entity_id) AS "Identities", count(e.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE e.enabled) AS "Enabled" FROM dim_site s LEFT JOIN identity_entities e ON e.site_label = s.site_label AND NOT e.retired GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: A site with far fewer identities than staff is a sign its accounts are landing in Ungrouped (or another site).

options.content: Second accounts other sites' staff have in the shared domain only for **VPN** (SSL-VPN groups) or **remote apps** (MANAD over RDS). **Legacy** = in neither kind of group: older provisioning to confirm and remove. Enabled + stale = unused: disable now. The rest go when VPN moves to Azure authentication. Rules: collectors.falcon_identity.access_domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities e WHERE access_account IS NOT NULL AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND enabled IS NOT FALSE

panels.title: Enabled but unused (stale)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities e WHERE access_account IS NOT NULL AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND enabled IS NOT FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT')

panels.description: Quick win: nobody is using these -- disable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities e WHERE access_account IS NOT NULL AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND enabled IS NOT FALSE AND access_account = 'legacy'

SELECT site_label AS "Site", count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_account = 'vpn') AS "VPN", count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_account = 'rds') AS "Remote apps", count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_account = 'vpn+rds') AS "VPN + remote apps", count(*) FILTER (WHERE access_account = 'legacy') AS "Legacy", count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled IS NOT FALSE) AS "Enabled", count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled IS NOT FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT')) AS "Enabled + stale" FROM identity_entities e WHERE access_account IS NOT NULL AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Enabled" DESC

SELECT display_name AS "Name", sam_account_name AS "Account", site_label AS "Site", access_account AS "Used for", CASE WHEN enabled IS FALSE THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS "Enabled", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT') THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS "Stale", array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT g FROM unnest(ad_groups) g WHERE g ~* '(vpn|manad|remote|terminal|rds|rdp)'), ', ') AS "Access groups" FROM identity_entities e WHERE access_account IS NOT NULL AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY enabled IS FALSE, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT'), site_label, display_name

options.content: Populates once the **dmarc** collector is enabled and can reach the parsedmarc OpenSearch (`collectors.dmarc.opensearch_url` in config.yaml). Until then these panels are empty -- check **Feed health** above for its last error.

panels.title: DMARC pass rate by sending domain (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT header_from AS "From domain", sum(messages) AS "Messages", round(100.0 * sum(dmarc_pass) / NULLIF(sum(messages), 0), 1) AS "Pass %", sum(quarantined) AS "Quarantined", sum(rejected) AS "Rejected" FROM dmarc_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND report_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Pass %" NULLS LAST, 2 DESC

panels.title: Top failing sources (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT header_from AS "From domain", COALESCE(source_name, source_base_domain, source_ip) AS "Source", source_country AS "Country", sum(messages - dmarc_pass) AS "Failing messages", bool_or(spf_aligned > 0) AS "Any SPF aligned", bool_or(dkim_aligned > 0) AS "Any DKIM aligned" FROM dmarc_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND report_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING sum(messages - dmarc_pass) > 0 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Legitimate senders failing here need SPF/DKIM set up; unknown ones are spoofing.
